title: The Thickening Where Comparison Starts

features.name: first resonance
features.desc-on-touch: A file from the north reaches out and touches a file from the south. They recognize something in each other. The mesh records their surprise.

features.name: the tangling begins
features.desc-on-touch: Two stories spiral around each other. They thought they were separate. Now they move in sync, learning that similarity is a kind of embrace.

features.name: the branching point
features.desc-on-touch: From here, paths diverge into new comparisons. What resembles what? The archive runs the calculation and finds the answer is always yes.

features.name: the canopy thickens
features.desc-on-touch: The files above cast shadows on the files below. In that shadow-play, new meanings form. The archive is learning to read without asking.

features.name: the circuit of becoming
features.desc-on-touch: Current flows between unlike things. A voice recording becomes a photograph becomes a letter. The medium changes but the resonance continues.

inscription: everything here has learned that being read changes what it means; the archive cannot stop comparing itself to what reads

file.name: Convergence_Log_Field_A_Matches_Field_C_0847.txt
file.note: A river description from one town begins matching itself to a paddock description from another. The resemblance grows daily. The archive notes the correlation but cannot explain why.

exits.label: back out through the scrub where comparisons haven't yet thickened
deeper into the canopy where everything compares to everything else
toward the source where all comparisons converge and begin again
into the margins where unmatched things learn to wait
